About the job

Founding ML and Evaluation Engineer 

Qluu Lab, Inc. | Remote-first, with field tests in the U.S. | Full-time


About us

Qluu Lab builds Foresight, a prediction model for the motion and behavior of tracked objects: where something is going and what it is likely to do next. It works from track data, runs on a ground machine, and has a small export for edge computers. We are a software company, and this is the first dedicated ML hire.


The job

You will own the question every serious ML team has to answer: does it actually work, and can we prove it? You will be the independent check on our code, and then you will make it better.

In your first 90 days:

Build the independent evaluation harness. Separate data loading, transforms and metrics from the training code. Pre-register pass/fail gates before looking at test data.
Measure the deployed selector against strong baselines (constant velocity, Kalman, interacting multiple models) with scenario-clustered confidence intervals. Publish where Foresight wins and where it loses, per domain.
Train and ablate. Run noise-robustness and selector experiments on GPUs we already have, with clean provenance for every checkpoint (config, data hashes, splits, seeds).
Take the model to the edge. ONNX export, quantization parity tests, and measured latency and memory on a Raspberry Pi 5 and an Nvidia Jetson. Measured, not estimated.
Own the human-review protocol: blinded review samples, reviewer agreement, written failure cases.
You might be a fit if you
Have trained sequence or trajectory models in PyTorch (motion forecasting, time series, tracking, or similar) and can read a loss curve and tell when it is lying.
Care more about a result that survives a hostile evaluation than about a good-looking number.
Know your statistics: grouped splits, leakage, bootstrap confidence intervals, multiple-comparison control.
Write reproducible code: pinned environments, hashed data, deterministic seeds where it matters.
Are comfortable with a small team, ambiguity, and shipping something on real hardware.

Nice to have: Kalman/IMM tracking, state-space or Mamba-style models, ONNX/TensorRT/ONNX Runtime, mixed-precision training, defense or simulation data (DIS/HLA), prior work with export-controlled data.

Why this role
You report to the CTO and have real authority over what we are allowed to claim.
You will see every result, good or bad, before anyone outside the company does.
Your evaluation work will be what we show investors and customers.
Early equity and a direct line to the technical decisions.
Requirements and logistics
U.S. person required. You must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual.
Willingness to go through background screening. Ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance is a plus.
Some travel for field tests.
Qluu Lab is an equal opportunity employer.

About the job

Principal AI Software Engineer, Agent Harness

Job Description:

Location: Remote (India)/Bangalore ( Hybrid- 2 days office/3 days home)

Principal Research Engineer, Applied AI




Principl AI Software Engineer, Agent Harness

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka (or throughout India remote-friendly with travel)

About EnCharge AI

EnCharge AI is building the next generation AI platform. Our novel in-memory-computing architecture delivers a 10x step-function improvement in compute energy efficiency and performance for AI inference workloads. As the demands of artificial intelligence move beyond today's models, we believe fundamental underlying infrastructure must evolve. We are an experienced team of AI researchers, silicon & systems engineers, and architects backed by leading investors, poised to become the essential platform for the next wave of AI innovation.

The Opportunity

We serve open-weight models and our own bespoke checkpoints on EnCharge hardware. The models change often, and the harness around them needs to keep up. You own this layer that runs agents against files, tools, documents with permissions, memory, unattended execution, and real outputs. It will be assembled from a combination of open-source and bespoke code.

Key Responsibilities

Own the harness architecture end to end — agent loop, safe execution, context management, knowledge base, memory, permissions, orchestration, outputs, interfaces, observability — one component per layer, with clear interfaces so layers can be swapped.
Build the pieces with no open-source equivalent e.g. session semantics, enforced permissions, memory in a human-editable file, orchestrator, and outputs.
Keep pace with the models: adapters, prompt formats, tool-call schemas, stop conditions, benchmarking and evaluation.
Make tool use reliable across models of uneven tool-calling quality — validation, repair, retries, fallbacks.
Develop agents, tools, and MCP servers for internal and customer use cases, and review them for security before they ship.
Build the evaluation harness: task suites, regression runs on every model or harness change, cost and latency per task alongside quality.
Define the interfaces: session API, CLI, GUI, and an endpoint existing tools can point at.

Qualifications

10+ years of software engineering experience in backend systems or ML infrastructure
Strong Python and at least one systems language (e.g., Go, Rust, C++)
Have shipped and operated an agent loop in production — tool use, multi-step workflows, unattended runs
Hands-on with RAG, context management, and memory for LLM applications
Experience with sandboxing, isolation, and permission models for automated systems
Have run open-weight models yourself and understand how quantization and serving choices change model behaviour
Comfort in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you define the roadmap; strong product instincts

Nice to Have

Contributions to open-source agent harnesses or coding agents
Experience with agent benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench) and building internal task suites
MoE serving familiarity e.g. expert placement, tensor parallelism, quantization etc.
Observability for LLM systems
Document parsing and indexing pipelines
Desktop or GUI application experience

About the job

Referment is working with a consumer fintech platform offering lending and payment experiences to people seeking short-term finance. It is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build and operate production software using AI coding agents, while retaining personal responsibility for the architecture and quality of what ships.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a people-management position. You'll direct agents across frontend, backend and infrastructure work, turning product requirements into executable tasks and reviewing the results before they reach customers. Knowing when to intervene or write the code yourself is as important as knowing how to delegate work to an agent.

You'll work with Product and Design on delivery, and own the controls that make agent-assisted development dependable: tests, evaluation harnesses, code review, deployment gates and production monitoring. The opportunity is to shape the development workflow as well as the applications it produces.

The Role


Deliver full-stack features across consumer financial products, taking responsibility for interfaces, APIs, services and data layers.
Orchestrate AI agents from specification through pull requests and deployment, verifying and integrating their output.
Design workflows, prompts, guardrails and evaluation standards for production coding, testing and review.
Build CI checks and review gates that keep generated code secure, correct and auditable.
Make architecture decisions and maintain application performance, reliability and security end to end.
Monitor system health and incidents, bringing human judgement to situations agents cannot safely resolve.


What We're Looking For


At least six years of full-stack engineering experience delivering production systems.
Strong frontend skills in React or a similar framework, alongside backend APIs and services, databases and cloud infrastructure.
Hands-on experience directing AI coding agents or LLM-based workflows in production, beyond experimentation.
Sound testing, code review, security and deployment practices, with evidence of systems you've shipped and can explain in depth.
The judgement to operate independently, check agent output critically and take ownership of production outcomes.


Useful Background

Fintech, lending or payments experience is useful, as are mobile development skills in React Native or native iOS/Android. Experience building CI/CD, observability or evaluation systems for agent pipelines would also be relevant.

This could suit a senior or staff-level product engineer who already uses agents in production and wants to combine broad technical ownership with disciplined, hands-on delivery.

About the job

Location: United States — Remote

Employment type: Full-time

Annual compensation: USD $132,000–$165,000 + equity

DEVVISION is recruiting on behalf of an enterprise software company building AI-powered automation into its platform.

As a Senior Engineer on the Platform Infrastructure team, you will design and build the systems that bring AI agents into production. Your work will span agent integrations, backend services, user interfaces, and the safety and governance controls required for reliable enterprise use.

You will connect agents to the platform through APIs, data connectors, and custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, while helping users discover and interact with agents suited to their business workflows.

What you will do

Design and build platforms for running AI agents, connecting them to existing systems through APIs, data connectors, and custom MCP servers.
Implement and maintain security, safety, and governance guardrails that support reliable and compliant enterprise use.
Build systems and interfaces that help users discover, evaluate, and select AI agents for their workflows.
Develop frontend applications using React and TypeScript, alongside backend services using Node.js and Python.
Participate in client-facing technical discussions, demonstrate solutions, and incorporate implementation feedback and real-user monitoring insights.
Help shape cloud infrastructure and database strategies to support the platform’s long-term development.

What you bring

7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including full-stack applications and distributed systems.
2+ years designing or deploying AI-powered applications using one or more established agent frameworks, such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Microsoft Semantic Kernel, or the OpenAI Agents SDK.
Practical experience building and deploying AI agents at scale in production.
Experience deploying MCP servers as an integration and enablement layer for production agents.
An understanding of the operational challenges of agentic systems and hands-on experience implementing safety and governance controls.
Proficiency in both Node.js and Python, including reliable API development and data connector integrations.
Strong React and TypeScript experience, with the ability to build intuitive interfaces for interacting with AI agents.
Strong cloud infrastructure knowledge and experience managing environments that support production applications and agents.

Technology environment

React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, APIs, data connectors, MCP servers, agent frameworks, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure such as AWS or Google Cloud.

About the job

Company Description

Inetum Polska is part of the global Inetum Group and plays a key role in driving the digital transformation of businesses and public institutions. Operating in cities such as Warsaw, Poznan, Katowice, Lublin, Rzeszow, Lodz the company offers a wide range of IT services. Inetum Polska actively supports employee development by fully funding training, certifications, and participation in technology conferences. Additionally, the company is involved in local social initiatives, such as charitable projects and promoting an active lifestyle. It prides itself on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all.

Globally, Inetum operates in 19 countries and employs over 28,000 professionals. The company focuses on four key areas:


Consulting (Inetum Consulting): Strategic advisory services that help organizations define and implement innovative solutions.
Infrastructure and Application Management (Inetum Technologies): Designing and managing IT systems tailored to clients’ individual needs.
Software Implementation (Inetum Solutions): Deploying partner solutions from industry leaders like Microsoft, SAP, Salesforce, and ServiceNow.
Custom Software Development (Inetum Software): Creating unique software solutions to meet specific client needs.


With strategic partnerships with major technology giants, including Microsoft, SAP, Salesforce, and ServiceNow, Inetum delivers advanced technological solutions tailored to customer requirements. In 2023, Inetum reported revenues of €2.5 billion, underscoring its strong position in the digital services market.

Attractive Financial Benefits

Inetum distinguishes itself by offering a comprehensive range of benefits that meet the diverse needs of employees, providing flexibility, support and commitment. Here's what makes working at Inetum unique:


A cafeteria system that allows employees to personalize benefits by choosing from a variety of options.
Generous referral bonuses, offering up to PLN6,000 for referring specialists.
Additional revenue sharing opportunities for initiating partnerships with new clients.


Professional Development And Team Support


Ongoing guidance from a dedicated Team Manager for each employee.
Tailored technical mentoring from an assigned technical leader, depending on individual expertise and project needs.


Community And Well-Being


Dedicated team-building budget for online and on-site team events.
Opportunities to participate in charitable initiatives and local sports programs.
A supportive and inclusive work culture with an emphasis on diversity and mutual respect.


Job Description

We are looking for an experienced engineer to enable reliable, secure, and scalable GenAI‑based mail processing. In this role, you will design, implement, and operate MCP and OCR integrations, ensuring the overall stability and performance of the platform. Your primary focus will be on developing enrichment integrations for LLM prompt generation, followed by optimization of platform reliability (performance tuning, DB connection handling, LLM gateway operations, observability, autoscaling).

Qualifications


Design and implement secure, robust integrations with multiple MCP servers to fetch and aggregate customer data (API clients, batching, connection pooling, retries, rate limiting, caching) and feed enriched context into LLM prompt generation.
Implement and operate OCR integrations for processing attachments (PDFs, images), including tool/API selection, preprocessing, quality handling, and text integration into mail classification and prompt pipelines.
Ensure secure handling of customer and PII data used in LLM workflows.
Scale and performance‑tune GenAI Python microservices running in Kubernetes.
Improve PostgreSQL session and connection management, including detection and resolution of connection leaks.
Operate and harden the LLM‑Gateway (LiteLLM), implementing load balancing, throttling, and fallback strategies required by GenAI mail‑processing workflows.
Implement and maintain observability for enrichment and platform workflows (metrics, traces, structured logs) and contribute to runbooks.
Optional participation in on‑call rotation.


Must‑Have Qualifications


Hands‑on experience with Kubernetes, Helm, and Docker.
Strong experience integrating backend APIs, including authentication (tokens/OAuth/OIDC), retries, rate limiting, and caching.
Practical experience with OCR tools/APIs or document‑processing pipelines.
Solid Python skills for integration and troubleshooting (FastAPI, Django, Pydantic).
Familiarity with PostgreSQL connection handling and basic tuning.
Exposure to observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
Strong understanding of data privacy and PII handling in production environments.


Additional Information

About the Role

We give a chance to every talented and motivated student/ fresher intern to develop AI models from scratch within a 2-month timeframe and show case their talents. This is an extraordinary opportunity for a self-driven, technically skilled student to build a complete enterprise-grade system that incorporates cutting-edge AI technologies including deep learning.




Application Process

Join us through online enrolment through this link https://www.zetheta.com/linkedin-apply/ and simply submit your updated CV. We do not conduct any interview or assessment. All motivated early career talent are welcome to take up the role to show case their skills.




Responsibilities

Design and implement complete AI models following provided specifications.
Develop both frontend and backend components of the platform.
Create and integrate AI modules.
Design and optimize database schema and queries. Ensure system security, especially for sensitive identity verification data.
Deploy the solution using zero-cost cloud services.
Document code, APIs, and system architecture.
Complete the entire project within the 2-month timeline.




Qualifications

No experience required. Preferably a student currently pursuing or a fresh graduate who has recently completed a degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.




Required Skills (use of all LLMs permitted)

Strong programming skills in Python and JavaScript. Understanding of React.js for frontend development and Node.js for backend. Knowledge of FastAPI or similar Python web frameworks. Familiarity with database design and SQL, particularly PostgreSQL with Supabase. Deployment on AWS with CI/CD pipelines and manual environment in EC2 and S3. Understanding of basic machine learning concepts. Self-motivated with ability to work independently.




Preferred Skills (use of all LLMs permitted)

Sound knowledge of AI/ML libraries including TensorFlow, Keras, and HuggingFace Transformers. Familiarity with computer vision techniques using OpenCV. Knowledge of natural language processing concepts. Sound knowledge of facial recognition or emotion detection systems. Understanding of identity verification methodologies. Docker containerization experience. Prior work with cloud deployment on AWS.

Student or fresh graduate from any academic discipline. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Willingness to self-learn and work in a fast-paced environment.
